kerrington gillespie.bio: Kerrington Gillespie is a country-pop singer and songwriter from Vancouver Island. Her releases include “New Boyfriend” and “Three Missed Calls,” with live performances at venues and festivals across British Columbia.

p'tit belliveau.bio: P'tit Belliveau is the project of Acadian musician Jonah Guimond, from Baie Sainte-Marie, Nova Scotia. His songs include “Income Tax” and “J’aimerais d’avoir un John Deere,” while his albums Greatest Hits Vol. 1 and Un homme et son piano both reached the Polaris Music Prize long list. Hear “C'est fine” on Northern Dial.

lydia képinski.bio: Lydia Képinski is a Montreal singer and songwriter recording for Chivi Chivi. She won the Francouvertes in 2017, and her albums Premier juin and Depuis both reached the Polaris Music Prize long list. Her catalog also includes C'est parti!, with the track of the same name now playing on Northern Dial.

k!ra oji.bio: K!RA OJI is a rapper and songwriter who moved from Angoulême, France, to Montreal's South Shore as a teenager.
